text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Sie können positive Einwirkungen nutzen und negative erfolgreich ausgleichen.", "gist": "Positive impacts can be utilized and negative impacts can be successfully balanced."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Safety Office", "gist": "Safety Office"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "UVEK", "gist": "UVEK (Swiss Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Das Safety Office betrachtet die Sicherheitsaufsicht im UVEK als gesamtheitliches System.", "gist": "The Safety Office views safety supervision within UVEK as a holistic system."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Dies umfasst Menschen, Technologien und Strukturen zur Gewährleistung der Sicherheit (Safety).", "gist": "This includes people, technologies, and structures to ensure safety."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "identifiziert das Safety Office die Themen, die zu bearbeiten sind", "gist": "The Safety Office identifies the topics to be addressed"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "es entwickelt gemeinsam mit den UVEK-Ämtern innovative Lösungen", "gist": "it develops innovative solutions together with UVEK offices"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "bewertet das Ergebnis anhand der Vorgaben", "gist": "evaluates the results based on the requirements"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "passt die Sicherheitsaufsicht UVEK im Hinblick auf seine Vision an", "gist": "adjusts UVEK safety supervision in line with its vision"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Mission", "gist": "Section title: Mission"}]}
